title: Golden Wok-Fried Noodles
description: A Chinese-inspired stir-fry dish with golden noodles, vegetables, and a hint of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown (3-4 minutes).
Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted (1-2 minutes).
Add the soy sauce, sesame seeds, and stir to combine.
Add the golden noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional sesame seeds and spinach if desired.
